items.title: Nukes
items.desc: Cold-war territory control on a hex map. Hostages fuel your moves but reinforce your enemy. Build bases, convert isotopes, and threaten nuclear strikes.

items.title: Planet Mongo
items.desc: Hex-based territory control in the Flash Gordon universe. Eight factions fight for dominance across 127 hexagonal tiles with hidden orders, bluffing, and a dynamic central market.

items.title: Endless Skies
items.desc: 4X space exploration with worker placement and fleet management. Eight asymmetric factions compete across a hex-tile galaxy, placing crew in ship rooms and diplomats in space ports to complete contracts for victory points.

rules_section.heading: Every rule in a git repo
rules_section.body: {{counts.games_count}} game families, {{counts.rules_variants}} variants, printable PDFs, and board diagrams. All under open licences. Fork a rulebook, write a variant, or just read the rules before game night.

cta.heading: More games on the horizon. All open source
cta.body: Every game ships with moddable files, version-controlled rules, and community hooks. Built on engines you can embed, extend, or fork.
